description:
Be visionary 
 
 Teledyne Technologies Incorporated provides enabling technologies for industrial growth markets that require advanced technology and high reliability. These markets include aerospace and defense, factory automation, air and water quality environmental monitoring, electronics design and development, oceanographic research, deepwater oil and gas exploration and production, medical imaging and pharmaceutical research. ​ 
 
 We are looking for individuals who thrive on making an impact and want the excitement of being on a team that wins.
   
 Job Description 
   
 Production Engineer – TWT Post‑Exhaust Assembly 
 Join our advanced manufacturing team supporting high‑reliability electronic products, where your expertise will directly impact yield, quality, and production excellence. In this role, you will own and continuously improve post‑exhaust assembly processes for Traveling Wave Tubes (TWTs)—ensuring every build is safe, consistent, and optimized for first‑time pass yield. Working closely with cross‑functional engineering and operations teams, you’ll be a key driver of scalable, precision manufacturing from the shop floor to documentation control. 
 
 What you’ll do 
 Define, validate, and own post‑exhaust assembly processes, including preparation, testing, and final packaging stages 

 Develop and maintain clear, unambiguous assembly procedures to ensure consistent execution 

 Create and manage travelers and routings that capture critical data for traceability and yield improvement 

 Specify, release, and validate production tooling to ensure precision, repeatability, and product integrity 

 Drive first‑time pass yield by embedding control points and critical parameter tracking into processes 

 Partner with engineering and quality teams to incorporate lessons learned into procedures and documentation 

 Support implementation of new processes and tooling on the shop floor, including operator training 

 Ensure alignment between released documentation and actual production practices 

 Support audits and ensure compliance with configuration control and quality system requirements 

 Participate in engineering change orders and process improvement initiatives 

 
 What you need 
 Strong ability to define and document manufacturing processes and assembly methods – required 

 Experience creating procedures, travelers, and tooling in a production environment – required 

 Proven understanding of shop‑floor operations and operator workflows – required 

 Ability to analyze process performance and drive yield improvements – preferred 

 Experience in high‑reliability manufacturing environments – required 

 Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Manufacturing Engineering (or related) – required 

 Experience with vacuum electronics, RF assemblies, or high‑voltage systems – preferred 

 Familiarity with contamination‑sensitive processes and traceability systems – preferred 

 
 What we offer 
 Opportunity to work on cutting‑edge, high‑reliability technologies 

 Collaborative, cross‑functional engineering environment 

 Strong visibility and impact on manufacturing performance and continuous improvement 

 Career growth in advanced manufacturing and engineering leadership
 (Additional benefits such as compensation, healthcare, or bonuses can be added based on company specifics.) 

 
 What happens next 
 
 After you submit your application, our recruiting team will review your experience and contact qualified candidates for an initial discussion. Further steps may include technical interviews and onsite or virtual meetings with the hiring team. 
   
 Salary Range: 
$90,800.00-$121,100.000 
 
 The anticipated salary range listed for this role is only an estimate. Actual compensation for successful candidates is carefully determined based on several factors including, but not limited to, location, local regulations (such as minimum wage), education/training, work experience, key skills, and type of position.
